Subject: Next steps: MedFast pilot milestones & evidence checklist

Hi Alex / Priya — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared starting point for the pilot MAP. I've attached a working spreadsheet (MedFast_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 extract you requested.

Highlights from discovery:
- Primary use case: discharge-summary generation for outpatient clinics (latency SLOs matter for UI flows).
- Decision criteria: accuracy on clinical prompts (>95% preferred), inference latency under 400ms 95th pct, predictable cost per 1k tokens.
- Security/legal ask: SOC2 evidence, data residency for logs, and confirmation on PII processing model.
- Procurement: MedFast prefers a 60–90 day pilot with success criteria before committing to reserved capacity.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer we should loop in? (we discussed finance ownership but didn't lock a name)
2) Who is the primary security/legal contact for evidence collection?
3) Please review the attached MAP draft and mark owners/priority milestones — I assigned a first pass based on today's call.

Proposed pilot milestones (high level):
- Pilot kickoff / tech onboarding: target week of 6/26
- Data ingress & secure connectivity: owner = MedFast security (evidence items 1–3)
- Evaluation period + prompt set: 3 weeks after onboarding
- Final decision checkpoint & terms: within 60 days of kickoff

If these look reasonable I'll circulate an updated MAP with concrete dates and owners (Ben will own the onboarding runbook, Priyom will support the security evidence intake).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—Marissa

3) Data onboarding & sample validation (seed data, agreed prompt set) — 2028-07-06 (owner: MedFast/Redwood joint)
4) Model validation / prompt tuning window (2 weeks) — 2028-07-07 to 2028-07-21 (owner: Redwood)
5) Evaluation review & decision checkpoint — 2028-08-01 (owner: Priya / MedFast leadership)

Action items for this thread:
- MedFast: confirm Samir as security evidence owner and Priya as decision owner (please confirm by EOD Mon 6/17).
- Redwood: provide the short one-pager on encryption & retention (Priyom to send) and finalize pilot cost estimate.
- Schedule kickoff: propose Mon 6/26 10:00am PT — Marissa to send calendar invite upon confirmation.
